newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.034pts to 101.413.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.034pts to 101.413.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.034 points in Monday's trading to 101.413, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.449 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.038 points to 97.636, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.222 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 0.807 points to 1,120.547.
